scope: Nine Wave32 bitwise operations in boolean_functions, including selected half and preservation of the other half. Per-bit AND/OR/XOR/NOT/XNOR truth tables are a direct specification-derived exact reference, independent of numeric rounding. Every truth-table input at each bit and selector is checked, with exhaustive half encodings and deterministic full words. Exact integer results are required even when the API semantics selector is loose.
diagnostics: Per-output assertion identifies operation, CPU, modifier and lane; no opaque golden digest is used.

scope: Six Wave32 add/sub/subrev/add3 operations. int64_t computes signed or unsigned widened sums/differences without overflow (three uint32_t inputs sum below 2^34); explicit clamp then uint32_t narrowing implements saturation or modulo 2^32. Independent literal boundaries check operand order, signed limits, borrow and ADD3 clamp behavior. This simple integer model is an exact oracle; fuzzy FP comparison is inapplicable.
diagnostics: Boundary/random tests trace operation, CPU, clamp and batch; literal cases separately expose saturation and operand-order regressions.

scope: The 20 scalar operations in scalar_integer_call, their immediate variants and additional sign-extension checks. Hardware digests cover result low/high words and SCC over 4096 boundary/random pairs, both incoming SCC values and both semantics. Immediate ADDK/MULK computed references use bounded int64_t arithmetic and explicit narrowing; literal ABS_DIFF cases preserve its wrap-before-absolute ordering. Aliasing checks are differential memory checks, not separate numerical oracles.
diagnostics: Each hardware failure identifies CPU, semantics, incoming SCC and one opcode/immediate row (4096 pairs). Literal boundaries and exhaustive immediate assertions complement those compact row digests; dense-domain checkpoints are not needed for these small rows.

scope: 84 RDNA4 Wave32 FP16/32/64 CMP/CMPX predicate entry points. Exact mask results are anchored by hardware captures across modifiers, masks and input-denormal policy. The independent integer-bit reference applies selectors, ABS then NEG, optional flush, NaN unordered handling and signed-zero equality; sign/magnitude order implements finite comparisons without host FP arithmetic. Every half encoding is checked with representative operand pairing, not all 2^32 half pairs. Optional exception-state behavior is reviewed separately.
diagnostics: Hardware digest identifies CPU, denormal policy, mask and predicate. Independent boundary/every-half tests report predicate/modifier/input batch. DPP capture and per-output routing checks complement each other.

scope: FP32 RCP/SQRT/RSQ/EXP/LOG exact implementations borrowed from rocjitsu, both architectures and wave widths. Dense domains use retained raw hardware digests; modifier/exponent/special-value domains have per-policy/per-modifier digests. Rocjitsu-generated cumulative checkpoints reproduce all five hardware totals. DPP comparisons to a non-DPP invocation check routing/alias behavior and do not independently prove the numeric model. Architecture-specific NaN and OMOD assertions remain literal anchors.
diagnostics: Dense captures now stop at the first failing 2^20-input interval. Modifier captures localize to operation, wave width, FP policy and modifier (8192 inputs).
